text:
leo: Heads up: release-bot grouped three forced patches into the Features section of the notes because their tags included buildmeta (v2.8.1+build.123). Anyone seen this before?

anya: Ugh yeah. Our changelog parser treats buildmeta as pre-release marker sometimes and maps to Features. It shouldn't. Buildmeta should be ignored for bucketization.

sam: Quick thread: the CI tag job has `--append-buildmeta` enabled by default for nightly. That causes the generator to misclassify. We should avoid buildmeta in final tags for patches.

release-bot: FYI: tagging logic -> if tag contains '+' or '-' it's considered non-stable -> candidate for Features/Unreleased. Rule: +buildmeta currently toggles special handling. Manual override: add frontmatter `section: Bugfixes` in PR body to force bucket.

leo: Two things we need: 1) short-term: a script to strip buildmeta before release-note bucketization, or ensure release pipeline reads semver core only. 2) long-term: change tagger to keep buildmeta out of semver tags for stable releases.

anya: Agreed. Also the deploybot sometimes creates `-rc.N` tags for patch backports which confuses the generator. RCs should map to the same section as the target release, not to Features.

sam: Workaround I used: add `semver: patch` and `section: Bugfixes` YAML frontmatter to the PR body. Deploy-bot will copy frontmatter into the tag message and the notes generator respects it. But that's ugly to rely on manual frontmatter.

leo: Can we make release-bot annotate the PR when it tags automatically, showing the computed bucket and a link to override? e.g., "assigned section: Features (reason: pre-release tag detected). Click to force Bugfixes."

release-bot: enhancement queued: rfc/notes-heuristics#9. Will add annotation and a CLI `release-bot annotate --section Bugfixes` shortcut. Also will default to ignoring buildmeta when classifying semver for release-notes.

docbot: note: docs generator will be updated to treat `+build` as metadata only. PR: docs/notes-parser#42 opened.

anya: One more subtlety: when devs squash commits and CI appends buildmeta (sha), the git tag sometimes becomes `v1.2.3+sha.abcd`. Our release pipeline earlier filtered that out, but the newer changelog tool is stricter. We need a unit test for semver parsing in the pipeline.

sam: I can add a unit test in releng CI that asserts tags with `+` still parse to the same major.minor.patch. Will do. Also add an integration test to ensure features/bugfix bucketing remains stable.

leo: Also policy ask: during stable windows, prefer not to use buildmeta in tags for any forced patches. It's noise and breaks downstream dependency pinning for enterprise users.

release-bot: noted. Policy RFC suggested: rfc/tagging-and-buildmeta#3. Plan: nightly builds keep buildmeta, final release tags avoid it unless `--include-buildmeta` explicitly set by release-approvers.

anya: TL;DR: short-term fixes: patch notes generator to ignore buildmeta; add PR annotation and override button; unit tests. Long-term: tagging policy change.

sam: I'll open the quick-fix PR for the notes parser and add the unit tests. tagging policy RFC next week.

leo: Thanks. Also remind folks that `[PATCH]` in PR title still forces patch naming and helps the bots. Posting to #release-notes: "Fix: generator now ignores +buildmeta for section grouping; forced patches restored to Bugfixes."

release-bot: applied: updated tagging message for the three impacted tags and moved entries to Bugfixes. Closing thread.
